response_to_jennifer.summary: Agree with Jennifer round 1. After visual saturation against the Doc23 raw/crop resources, I made no label corrections, no additions, and no reassertions of the 14 removed edges.
accepted_removed_edge_classes: Direct BUS-120AC-A/B to INST-NIS-A/B taps removed because the NIS instruments are on dashed RPS/NIS routes, not direct AC-bus taps.
Six CB-*-MAIN to BUS-480-* detached-dot links removed because the main-breaker bottom dots are visually separated from the 480 V horizontal buses.
Six JB-*-1 to second-relay shortcuts removed because the visible control path goes through the first relay before the second relay.

extraction_notes: Round 2 saturation pass used only Doc23 Raw + components resources plus Diego/Jennifer round 1 proposal/review inputs; no Ground Truth, GT-derived files, Raw+wires folders, OCR engines, or outside resources were used.
Raw schematic remained authoritative; overlay/crops were used only as visual aids for component position and disputed geometry.
Direct-edge semantics preserved: no same-net cliques, bus nodes connect only to directly tapped devices/feeders/instruments/grounds, and crossings without black junction dots are not connections.

Accepted Jennifer removal of the two direct BUS-120AC-A/B to INST-NIS-A/B edges after rechecking raw_37/raw_38: each NIS instrument is on a dashed route from the RPS panel area, not a direct AC-bus tap.

Accepted Jennifer removal of six CB-*-MAIN to BUS-480-* edges after rechecking representative load-center crops: the main-breaker bottom dots are detached from the 480 V buses and remain uncertain, not asserted.

Accepted Jennifer removal of six JB-*-1 to second-relay shortcuts after rechecking relay/control crops: the drawn control path reaches the second relay through the first relay, with no clear separate JB-to-second-relay endpoint.
The 21 Jennifer uncertain candidates are retained as uncertain and are not asserted.
